title: MDL rule: which documents the project needs, per plant / system / structure / construction area / MR, with quantity basis, effort, inputs and links (engine mdl sync)

title.description: title template: {name} = scope title, {part} = part number

originator.description: SUPPLIER = supplier of the MR (IEC for iec_supply packages, else mr.supplier_code)

categories.description: system scope: system categories the rule applies to

parties.description: system / structure scope: design party of the system (IEPC, IEC)

systems.description: explicit system / structure / CWA ids (restricts the scope)

package_types.description: mr scope: package types (iec_supply, equipment, bulk, subcontract)

quantity.description: system q_ field (plant / cwa / mr scope: summed over the systems of the scope); empty = one sheet

min_sheets.description: sheets when the quantity is small (default 1); the rule applies only where the quantity is > 0 unless min_sheets > 0 and quantity is empty

max_sheets.description: sheets per document; larger quantities are split into parts

kks.description: KKS part of the number for plant-scope rules (default 00000)

inputs.description: rule ids (DL-..., optional @plant / @cwa / @system / @structure) or doc:<document id>

ewp_disc.description: construction documents: discipline code of the CWP whose EWP the document belongs to

ewp_seq.description: CWP sequence number (default: highest of the discipline in the CWA)

mr.description: procurement link for system / plant scope documents

po_weeks_ifr.description: supplier documents: weeks after the PO (>= 0) or, when negative, weeks before shipment (on-site date - transport); weeks after the PO scale with manufacture_weeks / 40 (0.5 - 1)

start_after.description: copied to the documents: bids = start after the bids of the MR are received (requisition IFC + bid_days); alap = as late as possible (latest start - 60 working days)

po_weeks_final.description: supplier documents: weeks after the PO, or relative to shipment (on-site date - transport) when po_weeks_ifr is negative

equipment_types.description: eqgroup scope: equipment types (one document per system + MR + equipment type group)

supply.description: eqgroup scope: supplying party of the equipment (e.g. IEPC)

cwa.description: plant scope: construction area whose EWP the documents belong to
